title: Date Picker
description: A date typed segment by segment or picked from a calendar the button beside it opens; joins a Field around it.

components.DatePicker: Lets the user type a date, or pick it from a calendar the button beside it opens.
components.DatePickerContent: The popover a DatePicker's or DateRangePicker's calendar opens in, lined up with the field.
components.DatePickerTrigger: The calendar button at the end of a DatePicker's or DateRangePicker's field.
